QUOTE: Enabling it takes two settings, not one. `check_config.h:995-1010` requires `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` plus exactly one of `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` or `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT`, and both of those are also off by default.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the macros that gate the locking code.
